title: AITA for telling my husband I don’t want his mother to visit us?
question: AITA for telling my husband I don’t want his mother to visit us?
body:
Normally my MIL visits us every spring. She works at a school so she spends spring break with us. She is a kind and sweet woman, but she lets her daughter push her around and is not very bright. I have to keep a close eye on her to make sure she’s not creating dangerous situations for my small children. I like her, but it’s difficult to have her here. 

Last summer she planned to come out in July (without asking us first) instead of March with my SIL and her husband as well . Turns out this was all the sisters idea. My SIL has never visited us, never met either of my children. Overall is just a terrible person. I can’t stand her because of the way she treats my husband. 

So basically it went like this: 
SIL: We’re coming out for this week in July. 

Me: That’s not a good time for us, Husband can’t take time off work that week. I have plans. Let’s look at a different week. 

SIL: No that’s all we can do. So we will be there. End of discussion. 

So I changed all my plans. We set up the beds. Had everything ready for a visit that we didn’t want to host. Then they don’t show up and check in on fb getting on a cruise ship. I have to say I was pretty relieved that I didn’t have to spend a week with my SIL and try to hide the fact that I’d like to kill her. My husband on the other hand was devastated. No one called him or let him know. We had to tell the kids memaw wasn’t coming to visit after all. It was a disaster. 

So now, my MIL wants to just pretend nothing ever happened and come visit us in March this year. I told my husband no. I said I don’t want her here until she acknowledges how badly she and her daughter hurt his feelings and the feelings of my kids. They were completely out of line and I will not ignore that! 

AITA for not allowing this to be swept under the rug?
